# @time-to-present/client

> Library a Presentation App uses to follow a Time to Present Performance: connect to the event stream, fold Named Events into seek-safe state, and run offline with a Simulator.

- [README](README.md): quickstart, seek safety, dev setup (Vite proxy of /_ttp to localhost:4747), React, Svelte and Vue recipes
- [Command line](README.md#reading-the-script-from-the-command-line): `npx ttp text` and `npx ttp events` print the Script Text and Named Events of a presentation.json, instead of reading it
- [Full reference](llms-full.txt): the whole API and protocol in one file
- [Protocol](docs/protocol.md): event stream and Script over HTTP, for non-JS clients
- [Folder format](docs/folder-format.md): the Presentation folder and optional app-src/
- [Examples](examples/vanilla-slides.ts): vanilla slides, React slides (examples/react-slides.tsx), word captions (examples/word-captions.ts)
